method: Read-only inspection of the original canonical last-25-second READ_3D windows; no runs, filters, thresholds, or summary measurements changed.
verification: Raw interval count, mean, p95, p99, and max exactly reproduce all 48 canonical records.
timeOrigin: Relative to each analyzed frame window, not the input or scene boundary.
ordinalMeaning: Process-start READ_3D event sequence; not guest simulation time, scene identity, completed GPU commands, or SDL presentations.
binMeaning: Five-second host-clock bins by interval endpoint; intervals may cross a bin or window boundary. The 200ms count is descriptive, not a new failure threshold.
attribution: Unresolved. These logs have no shared UTC/monotonic anchor for exact alignment with CPU/GPU samples, intermediate scene evidence, guest simulation timestamp, per-voice execution time, or GPU wait attribution.
